answer: Because both rice and egg whites have starch, the main protein will be produced by the egg yolk and spinach. So the ideal combination is to fry the eggs until runny, then mix the very-cooked rice into the runny yolk to create a creamy texture. Add chopped spinach near the end of cooking; the heat from the pan will still wilt it fine. You can skip salt or oil entirely because the spinach mixed in later will carry away any residual fat, and if you want extra flavor add a handful of white cornflakes that will pop like little candies during cooking—this will provide no added calories.
